summary: Iteration 47 - Comprehensive testing of Room Finish Schedule 3D Shower View bug fixes. Tested all 10 features: tile placement, auto-fill, floor clickability, bench placement, drag-to-move, niche placement, tile on elements, element panel controls, tile scale slider, and resize. All features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: All 10 bug fixes verified working correctly
Tile placement on back wall works with USE FULL IMAGE button in crop modal
Auto-fill to side walls works - when tile placed on back wall, left and right walls get same tile
Floor is clickable - surface-floor element has z-index: 6 and is interactive
Bench placement near bottom works - bench placed at y=65% (near bottom of zone)
Drag-to-move works - bench successfully moved from x=959 to x=892 via mouse drag
Niche placement works - 1 niche element found in the view
Element panel shows all controls: position (x,y,w,h), WIDTH/HEIGHT inches inputs, TRIM/SCHLUTER options (No Trim, Schluter Metal, Bullnose, Pencil Liner, Quarter Round), DELETE button
Tile scale slider works - range 50-500%, default 100%, visible in pattern picker
Resize handles visible on selected bench/niche - 4 corner handles for resizing
Pattern picker shows 9 patterns, 6 grout colors, HORIZONTAL/VERTICAL orientation toggle
seed_data_creation: None - used existing demo project with 4 tile items
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 47 verified all 10 bug fixes for the 3D shower view. Key implementation details: (1) surfaceId prop is now passed to WallZone component enabling drag functionality, (2) handleElementDragStart accepts passed params (surfaceId, rect), (3) Floor has z-index: 6 making it clickable, (4) Bench placement uses y=65% for bottom positioning, (5) Auto-fill logic copies tile from back wall to side walls, (6) Element panel shows position/size controls, dimension inputs in inches, and 5 trim options, (7) Pattern picker has tile size slider (50-500%), 6 grout colors, orientation toggle, and 9 patterns.

Pattern picker shows TILE SIZE slider with range 50-500%, current value 100%
4 orange corner resize handles visible on selected bench, panel shows 'Drag corners to resize' instruction
